description: Save a copy of a saved test, as Duplicate does in the Test Lab: every field of the test (mode, steps, variables, category, voice) under a new name, in the same suites unless suites says otherwise. Use it to start a variant of a test, then change the copy with update_test. Its runs are not copied.

name.description: The copy's name; left out, the test's name with (copy) after it.
name.title: Name

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

suites.description: Suites to put the copy in (ids or names); left out, the test's own suites.
suites.title: Suites

test.description: The saved test to copy, as list_tests shows it.
test.title: Test

name: copy_test
